method: E12_norm_ccdf_cldice_cv without all three extra terms: ResShift (E02's network and schedule) trained with the diffusion loss only (no extra terms) on MSU-normalised v3 prints; sampled CCDF-style with t0, start and projection chosen on v3 val as in E12
_ablation: loss ablation of E12: only 'aux_losses' differs from E12's params.json (all three extra terms dropped: the loss is L_diff alone). Data, seed, steps, schedule, network, gate, CCDF grid and selection rule are E12's
_normalization: every image the model sees (train, val, test) is fpr.data.normalization.normalize()d: train/val from script 10's copies, repair normalises its input on the fly. Its output is a normalised print, evaluated as stored against the normalised original and gallery (evaluate.py --rec-normalized, set by run_eval.py from output_normalized)

model._inputs: x_t (1) + cond: normalised damaged print, mask, cos 2theta, sin 2theta (4)

training.data: FixedTrainDataset(normalized=True) on v3: 6,308 crops x 6 contaminants x 3 copies = 113,544 samples, severity 0-0.8, MSU-normalised (script 10)

aux._note: unused: no extra terms. E12's settings, kept so that only 'aux_losses' differs from E12

ccdf._note: one_call = the model's own x0 estimate at t = T from x_T = y0 (E09's e02_x0); also scored: the full 15-step chain from y0 ('plain'). No regression control (E09 showed it within noise of the chain).
ccdf.selection: on v3 val, against the normalised gallery: tau = the score at which 1% of the clean (normalised) val samples' impostor comparisons are accepted; among configurations whose FMR at tau is at most plain's + fmr_margin, the highest acceptance rate of genuine comparisons at tau (score 1's quantity); ties -> higher mean genuine score -> fewer steps
